key: Station master here.\nWe've got your boarding passes.
en: Station master here.\nWe've got your boarding passes.
ja: こちら駅長です。\n乗車券をお持ちしました。

key: Another one for Reborn City, huh?
en: Another one for Reborn City, huh?
ja: また一人、リボーンシティ行きか。

key: They sure have been pushing that new League.
en: They sure have been pushing that new League.
ja: あの新しいリーグ、ずいぶん力を入れて宣伝してるみたいだな。

key: Let's see... Which one of these was it?
en: Let's see... Which one of these was it?
ja: ええと……どれだったかな。
これがお前だな?

key: Hey, quit playin' around and help me out here.
en: Hey, quit playin' around and help me out here.
ja: おい、遊んでないで手伝ってくれよ。
確かにそうみたいだな。

key: And what was your name again?
en: And what was your name again?
ja: それで、名前は何だったっけ?
\PN、って言ったよな?
分かった。

key: Then, just to be sure,\nfor 'Gender' I should put...
en: Then, just to be sure,\nfor 'Gender' I should put...
ja: それじゃ、念のため、\n「性別」の欄はと……
そうよ。

key: One sec. I'll handle the rest of this.
en: One sec. I'll handle the rest of this.
ja: ちょっと待ってな。あとはこっちでやっとくから。
よし、これで完了だ。

key: Just between you, me, and the ol' battered fence post,\nI hear Reborn City's kind of a dump.
en: Just between you, me, and the ol' battered fence post,\nI hear Reborn City's kind of a dump.
ja: ここだけの話だがな、\nリボーンシティって結構なゴミためらしいぞ。

key: Why anyone would wanna go there is beyond me.
en: Why anyone would wanna go there is beyond me.
ja: なんであんな所に行きたがるのか、オレにはさっぱり分からんね。

key: And yet, buncha you ambitious Trainer-type folk have been headin' out in droves.
en: And yet, buncha you ambitious Trainer-type folk have been headin' out in droves.
ja: それでも、野心満々のトレーナー連中が、次から次へと大挙して向かってるんだからな。
まあ、行ってこい。
もうすぐ電車が出るぞ。

key: Do you wish to view any information about the game?
en: Do you wish to view any information about the game?
ja: ゲームに関する情報を見ますか?

key: Reborn has Discord integration, which shares in- game activity updates on your status. You can turn this off in Options.
en: Reborn has Discord integration, which shares in- game activity updates on your status. You can turn this off in Options.
ja: リボーンはDiscord連携機能があり、ゲーム内の活動状況をステータスに共有します。オプションでオフにできます。

key: Controls can be reconfigured from the menu or by pressing F1.
en: Controls can be reconfigured from the menu or by pressing F1.
ja: 操作方法は、メニューまたはF1キーで再設定できます。

key: Note that some gamepad buttons may not be recognized by JoiPlay.
en: Note that some gamepad buttons may not be recognized by JoiPlay.
ja: ゲームパッドの一部のボタンは、JoiPlayで認識されない場合がありますのでご注意ください。
